titles.native: 和・和・和 ワッピちゃん

description: In a land where the past and the future connects, Watto Waapu, the young Wappi-chan encounters situations in which phrases with meanings rooted in the Japanese culture are used. She goes to the past through her dreams through which she learns right Japanese.
